reviewer: Codex primary implementer; independent audit remains separate

hunk_reviews.judgment: Removes the showPopover unsupported-browser early return from adjacent-popover placement. It changes private test eligibility, not product placement; preserve real legacy overlay structure requirements.
Removes the corresponding guard from popover reattachment beside the origin. Exact floor overlay routing is reachable and actual placement remains pending.
Removes the feature guard from custom-parent placement. Do not infer custom parent/legacy CSS compatibility from this source edit.
Removes the feature guard from origin-child placement. No production strategy code is changed; supported-browser coverage remains required.
Drops OverlayContainer from modern autocomplete test imports. The owned test still needs its actual container queries and keeps the public import.
Removes the modern autocomplete supportsPopover flag and container variable. Keep owned legacy panel/container assertions; do not treat current popover support as unreachable.

Removes modern autocomplete container setup/fallback host and backdrop query branches in favor of inline popover descendants. This changes test observation/location assumptions; retain legacy structure expectations and require actual native qualification.
Drops OverlayContainer from modern select test imports. Keep the owned public container import and legacy pane/backdrop queries.
Removes the modern select supportsPopover flag. Minimum public CDK still distinguishes supported and unsupported browser routing, which remains a native verification obligation.

Changes modern select host/backdrop helpers to fixture descendant queries, deleting container fallback lookups. Preserve owned legacy selectors/styles. The complete patch changes no select or overlay implementation.

decision: Review all ten hunks across all three original files. Four public-CDK private position tests lose browser-feature early returns; modern autocomplete/select helpers drop OverlayContainer fallback queries and assume inline popover descendants. The owned legacy specs retain real OverlayContainer, bounding-box/pane/backdrop and legacy panel queries, and their product paths reach the public overlay service/directive. Exact minimum CDK21.2.14/22.1.7 source enables popovers by default when supported and falls back without support, so the popover path is reachable and must not be excluded. Do not transplant modern inline-popover-only test selectors or erase legacy container/style expectations. This source-only decision declines the private helper rewrite; it neither disables popovers nor certifies existing DOM/style compatibility. Actual supported-browser, overlay structure, no-required-consumer-CSS and focus validation remains mandatory and may justify a narrow owned configuration repair.
